name: std::strrchr
intro: Finds the last occurrence of ch (after conversion to char) in the byte string pointed to by str. The terminating null character is considered to be a part of the string and can be found if searching for '\0'.

sections.title: Parameters
sections.text:
str

 -

 pointer to the null-terminated byte string to be analyzed


 ch

 -

 character to search for

sections.title: Return value
sections.text: Pointer to the found character in str, or null pointer if no such character is found.
